findings.text: non-blocking: _newest_write re-implements reckon/crew/routing.py:1893 _newest_mtime, the newest-write computation the retention sweep feeds to classify_item; the two differ in symlink resolution and in counting directory mtimes, so the listing can compute a different expiry from the sweep for the same item, the disagreement the plan forbids the listing and the sweep from having.

non-blocking: _handle_crew_post re-inlines the Content-Length bound and JSON body read that the existing Handler._read_body at reckon/serve.py:3936 already provides, a second copy of a helper the repository owns.

non-blocking: crew_persist_from_reports accepts payload data of any type and calls list(data), so a request whose data is a non-iterable raises TypeError out of the handler rather than answering a 400, an unvalidated boundary that turns a malformed request into a 500.
